programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique "rock rhyme" (yan yun)—a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: Quanzhou Puppet Theater: China’s "Pinocchio Adventure"
programme.desc: In the film, the puppet Pinocchio, carved and created by an old carpenter, comes to life as a real human. Puppets are lifeless by nature—it is the masterful skills of their puppeteers’ fingertips that breathe life into them. What does China’s own "Pinocchio Adventure" look like? This episode takes you into the world of Quanzhou String Puppet Theater. Explore behind-the-scenes stories, from the intricate carving of puppet heads to the art of puppet performance, and witness how the dance of ten fingers and threads weaves a thousand vivid characters to life!

programme.title: The Elegance of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world. In this episode, we’ll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we’ll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city’s annual Peony Festival, we’ll explore the significance of China’s national flower and national dress. Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we’ll learn something about the city’s culinary traditions. And finally, a master of tang sancai, or tri-color pottery, will discuss the legacy of this ancient craft and its place in the modern era.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing
programme.desc: From the local delicacies of Beijing's Ox Street to latest hangouts and contemporary cuisine of the Chinese capital, hosts Tianran He and Eva May will give you a true taste of Beijing, and the fascinating stories and people behind them.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing's Hutongs
programme.desc: The Hutongs in Beijing are considered the city's blood vessels, as these traditional alleyways make up the DNA of the capital for its rich history and culture. In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May zigzag their way through the Hutongs and the Forbidden City for a mouth-watering experience full of ancient and modern delicacies. Starring German designer Katrin, Russian artist Liuba and photographer Feng Yu from Beijing, our hosts are taking you along a journey that features fried noodles, dim sum, pancakes and co.!

programme.title: Foodwise: Changsha
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May embark on a journey to Changsha in Hunan Province.?They taste their way through the local cuisine, discover the city's latest art and fashion trends, and find out why this place is one of China's "influencer hotspots", attracting millions of domestic and foreign tourists each year.

programme.title: 2026 Spring Festival Gala Promo
programme.desc: China Media Group (CMG), the country's flagship broadcaster, has released a short video promoting its annual Spring Festival Gala, which will be broadcast live around the world on the evening of February 16.

programme.title: Foodwise：Qingdao
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. With red tiles and green trees that make up the city's stunning scenery, our hosts embark on another foodie-journey with local delicacies and interesting guest appearances. From drinking beer with a German friend, catching crabs by the ocean and devouring grilled eel the classic Korean way, this episode will leave you hungry for more!

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuzhen
programme.desc: Join our hosts Tianran He and Eva May as they explore the boisterous event of Wuzhen's International Theatre festival, with colorful features of both theatrical and culinary nature. Foodie Tianran and art-lover Eva are accompanied by ubiquitous local street food, daily carnival performances and meet and greets with fascinating personalities. Let's set the stage for the beautiful merge of food and drama as they taste their way through the charming scene of Wuzhen.

programme.title: Aerial China III Ep.4
programme.desc: Shandong rises where two seas kiss beneath one China's most sacred peaks: Mount Tai. It's also a place where other currents and tides that have defined Chinese history and culture meet - from Confucian wisdom to maritime daring, ocean voyages and global trade, all roads lead to and from Shandong!

programme.title: Ningxia: Echoes of the Yellow River
programme.sub-title: Ningxia: Echoes of the Yellow River
programme.desc: Ningxia: Echoes of the Yellow River is a documentary focusing on the World Heritage sites and cultural–ecological conservation in the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region. Through the lens of Ningxia’s heritage stories, the film highlights China’s commitment to World Heritage preservation, ecological restoration, and cultural continuity — presenting to global audiences a land where history and modernity intertwine, and where desert and oasis coexist. By following the guardians of the Western Xia Imperial Tombs, desert restorers in the Tengger Desert, Great Wall rangers at Sanguankou, traditional sheepskin raft craftsmen, and managers of the Yellow River irrigation system in Qingtongxia, the program reveals Ningxia’s distinctive contributions to cultural heritage, natural ecology, and intangible traditions — and the enduring human spirit behind them.

programme.title: Race to the Rock
programme.desc: The Race to the Rock is an annual unsupported ultra-distance bicycle race through the Australian Outback organized by Jesse Carlsson. Unlike stage races, such as the Tour De France, ultra-distance races start and run continuously until the competitors finish the race, forcing them to make such strategic choices as whether it would be better to take time to eat or sleep, or to sacrifice those things and press on. Race to the Rock is an unsupported race, which means that racers are not permitted to draft or to obtain help from anything other than publicly available sources that are available for all. The course varies every year, but finishes at Uluru, also known as Ayers Rock, and has been so gruelling that only a very small percentage of the competitors have ever finished the race. Roads are mostly unsealed, with limited water supplies, and stretches of 400-500 kilometres at times with no food resupply available.

programme.title: The High
programme.desc: THE HIGH is a feature length documentary film about the making of the longest high altitude foot race in the world. The film follows the path of a group of extreme runners who individually decide to take part of a dangerous running experiment gone wrong. Indian race director Rajat Chauhan works against the advice of the military, his family and friends to create a race over the two highest passes in the world (above 17 500ft). The decline begins from the start, with runners collapsing from dehydration, hypothermia, and high-altitude sickness. And by its end finds the entire race in jeopardy and the prospect that no one finishes. Brought to life by archive footage, story recreations, and interviews, the film unfolds the events in the Himalayas of Northern India and gives a unique look into the lives of the extreme marathon runners involved. Uncovering the avalanches, athletes, and the high altitude elements. THE HIGH shows the rewards of determination, the dangers of obsession, and in the end leaves you with the answer of why they called it, the toughest race on earth. Directed by Barry Walton.

programme.desc: Caroline Gleich, a world class ski mountaineer, summited Mt. Everest last spring as part of her #ClimbForEquality campaign to raise awareness for gender equality. programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "Norway"
programme.desc: Een Ierse MTB-pro ontdekt en rijdt de mooiste routes die Noorwegen te bieden heeft, van de bergen tot de oceaan.

programme.title: Close Proximity S1 - "Fallon, Nevada"
programme.desc: Matt Field keert terug uit China en gaat naar Fallon, Nevada, om samen met zijn vader, Bruce Field, mee te doen aan de Fallon 250 - een wegrace van 250 mijl.

programme.title: Close Proximity S1 - "Preparing for Texas Motorway"
programme.desc: Professionele drifter Matt Field bereidt zich voor op de volgende Formula Drift stop op de Texas Motorway.

programme.title: FMX Nomads S1 - "FMX Nomads"
programme.desc: Ga mee op pad met Dan Whitby, Samson Eaton en Arran Powley voor een dag in het leven van globetrotting freestyle motorcrossteam Bolddog. Nu de nieuwste gebeurtenissen in hun nomadenplanning ze naar de buitenwijk van Amsterdam brengt, krijgt de crew te kampen met de uitdaging hun show te combineren met drifters zoals Luke Woodham en Steve 'Baggsy' Biagioni.

programme.title: Supercar Blondie: Living the Dream S1 - "Supercar Blondie: Living the Dream"
programme.desc: In Supercar Blondie: Living the Dream volgen we de reis van Alex Hirschi. Ze begon haar eigen vlog om 's werelds meest exclusieve, dure supercars te beoordelen en haar enorme bekendheid heeft ertoe geleid dat ze miljoenen volgers en haar eigen tv-serie heeft gekregen.

programme.title: Endurance - 24 Hours at Spa S1 - "Ahmad Al Harthy - Aston Martin Vantage"
programme.sub-title: Ahmad Al Harthy - Aston Martin Vantage
programme.desc: In dit profiel leren we Ahmad Al Harthy kennen, die in een Aston Martin Vanrage meedoet aan de 2018 Total 24 Hours of Spa wedstrijd, die op het circuit van Spa-Francorchamps gehouden wordt.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S2 - "Gymkhana"
programme.desc: De rookies volgen een Start Skills-sessie onder leiding van de legendarische Daryl Beattie en keren daarna terug naar het asfalt voor een gymkhana. Wie bedwingt het lastige parcours en pakt de punten?

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S2 - "Match Race Challenge"
programme.desc: In een primeur voor The Ultimate Rider racen de rookies voor het eerst zij aan zij in duo’s. De druk is enorm, want de jury kondigt een verrassingseliminatie aan—en pas later op de dag, bij de bekendmaking van de punten, ontdekken de rookies wie eruit ligt.

programme.title: Car Crews with Supercar Blondie S1 - "Las Vegas"
programme.desc: Supercar Blondie komt in een Lamborghini SVJ roadster aan in Las Vegas. Onder de vleugels van Patrick, oprichter van de Junkyard Pirates, wordt Alex meegenomen in de wereld van de rat rod: het thuis van de Amerikaanse mavericks en outsiders.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S1 - "Stripped"
programme.desc: Maak kennis met Nigel McNally en het team van Kestrel Beer, die graag een snelheidsrecord willen rijden in een gerestaureerde Riley Kestrel 9 uit 1930.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S2 - "Melbourne Motocross"
programme.desc: Honda-motocrosser Ryan Mitchell sluit zich bij de rookies aan voor een masterclass. Wie schittert deze week op de baan en weet eliminatie te vermijden?

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S2 - "Endurance"
programme.desc: De rookies staan voor hun moeilijkste uitdaging tot nu toe, die zowel mentaal als fysiek een zware beproeving is. Vervolgens moeten ze al hun resterende krachten verzamelen om een tijdrit op een uithoudingscircuit te voltooien.

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S3 - "Go Kart"
programme.desc: De rookies worden tot het uiterste gedreven op de kartbaan. Ze moeten hun rijvaardigheid bewijzen, want de karts kunnen snelheden van meer dan 100 kilometer per uur halen!

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S3 - "Rookie Surprise"
programme.desc: Dan ontdekken de rookies dat de druk nóg verder wordt opgevoerd. Tim Edwards, de baas van Ford Performance Racing, is op het circuit aanwezig om hun prestaties te beoordelen. Eén slechte run kan het einde betekenen van hun droom om in een V8 Supercar te rijden.

programme.title: Car Crews with Supercar Blondie S1 - "Las Vegas"
programme.desc: Supercar Blondie arrives in Las Vegas in a million dollar Lamborghini SVJ roadster. Taken under the wing of Patrick, founder of the Junkyard Pirates, Alex is brought into the rat rod world - home to American mavericks and outsiders.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "The Blazer"
programme.desc: A 1970 K5 Chevrolet Blazer undergoes a transformation with new paint, interior, and a diesel engine conversion.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "Shelly"
programme.desc: A neglected 1981 Porsche 911 SC is brought back to life and restored to its original factory specifications.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "Cabriolet"
programme.desc: A ruined and rested family heirloom 1962 Mercedes Benz 220 SE Cabriolet gets a restoration modification with a new Mercedes engine and a new interior with heated seats.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "Bringing Out The Big Guns"
programme.desc: It's mud, sweat, and gears as drivers battle it out in the toughest Ultra 4 race yet.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "California Metal Stampede"
programme.desc: It's all or nothing as underdog Tom Liu drives himself to the brink in a heart-stopping Ultra 4 race.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "It is what it is.."
programme.desc: Team Indiana, the underdogs of Ultra 4, take the fight to the enemy.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Six"
programme.desc: Nik explores Range Rover's history, tests the 2021 Volvo XC90 ReCharge hybrid, and rides the 2021 Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat Red Eye with Mike. He's wowed by the 2021 BMW 745e.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Seven"
programme.desc: Nike reviews the innovative 2021 Mercedes-Benz S Class. Mike explores how cities adapt for autonomous vehicles. Nik introduces the 2022 Acura MDX with Amazon Alexa, and the all-new 2022 Kia Carnival.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S1 - "Record Day - Part 2"
programme.desc: The Flying Kestrel takes on the final records attempts, and the shocking results leave everyone reeling.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "The Crash"
programme.desc: After driver Jon Webster crashes the Flying Kestrel at 148 mph, the team must work out what went wrong and have to decide if the dream of a land speed record is worth risking it all?

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "Bali"
programme.desc: We travel to Bali - Indonesia to meet an MTB pro rider who decided to start a new life dividing his time between surfing and riding active volcanos.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "New Zealand"
programme.desc: We meet one of the most famous MTB photographers in New Zealand and follow him during the biggest MTB competition in Rotorua.

programme.title: Gymkhana Grid Profiles S1 - "Ken Block"
programme.desc: Founder of The Gymkhana Grid and viral superstar, Ken Block, gives a detailed account of the creation of one of the fastest growing events in the world.

programme.title: Gymkhana Grid Profiles S1 - "Shane Lynch"
programme.desc: The world-famous Boyzone band is back on tour but for Shane Lynch, his true passion is motorsport. He hangs up his microphone and gets behind the wheel.

programme.title: Morbidelli Rising S1 - "Finding Nirvana"
programme.desc: How does a rider feel moments before the race that they have spent their life preparing for? Franco Morbidelli begins his first MOTOGP race weekend in Qatar.

programme.title: Morbidelli Rising S1 - "Chasing Happy"
programme.desc: The VR46 MotoRanch track created by Valentino Rossi as a place to fine tune the riding skills of a lucky few, is notoriously hard to access - until now.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S12 - "Just the Way You Are"
programme.desc: One of eight ever made, the 1971 In Violet Plymouth 'Cuda 383 is finished and ready for delivery; the crew reflects on the journey the car has taken before the final touches are put on.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Earth"
programme.desc: We find out more about the animals that have their feet firmly planted on or under the ground. And find out how their senses are tuned to survive. What we see above the ground is only a small part of the natural world.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Communication"
programme.desc: Animals use communication to attract mates,warn off predators, defend territory, or trick their prey. And of course, it’s the senses that play the key role - Sight, smell, taste, touch, and hearing - all are employed to send signals to others.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "The Most Amazing Senses"
programme.desc: In this last episode of Super Senses we take the grand final tour to see the greatest of all the special weapons that help some animals to govern the wilderness. In this episode we see it, hear it, touch it, smell it and taste it like animals do.

programme.title: Blue World S8 - "Jojo the Dolphin"
programme.desc: Jonathan’s entire family travels to the Turks & Caicos Islands in search of a famous local celebrity—Jojo the friendly dolphin. Then Blue World explores a hidden cave—keeping an eye out for the alligators, for which it’s named!

programme.title: Blue World S8 - "Blue Hole Adventure in Belize"
programme.desc: Jonathan and Zach explore the reefs and famous Blue Hole of Belize, where they find an amazing number of animals including curious groupers, a friendly shark, a coral cave full of tiny fish, and spooky deep stalactites!

programme.title: Blue World S8 - "Darkness All Around"
programme.desc: This episode celebrating diving in the dark features the Blue World team exploring an ocean cave in Belize known as Winter Wonderland, where all the formations are covered in a snow-like coating of light sand.

programme.title: Animal Armory S1 - "TEETH & CLAWS"
programme.desc: The master weapons of the animal world: teeth and claws, are the best instruments for hunting, defense and combat in the animal world.

programme.title: Wild Walk S1 - "Aquila"
programme.desc: Can wilderness be brought back to a land that has been overgrazed and farmed? The Karoo was once extensive across south Africa and home to a rich diversity of flora and fauna. Swati takes a wild walk there to see if the conservation plan is working

programme.title: Wild Walk S1 - "Cheetahs"
programme.desc: Can captive bred ambassador cheetahs of the Cheetah Outreach in Cape Town can help save their counterparts in the wild? Swati finds out if the motto of Cheetah Outreach, see it, Sense it, Save it, can help the wild cheetah?

programme.title: Wild Walk S1 - "Elephants"
programme.desc: Can the African elephant evers be tamed? Is it possible to sustain an entire tourism industry based on them being domesticated? Swati walks with the elephants of Knysna park while these questions are asked.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Impala"
programme.desc: With a high reproduction rate that leads to large numbers on reserves and are the staple diet for predators that keep their numbers in check. See how these highly adapted and unique animals get loaded and gently treated to “migrate” to a new home.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "White Rhino"
programme.desc: Another member of Africa’s Big 5 - the white rhino. Once on the brink of extinction, and today thanks to the conservation and breeding strategies, there are enough to relocate to other nature reserves to ensure the survival of this unique species.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Plains Game"
programme.desc: The technique to capture wildebeest and zebra involves an experienced team, a helicopter and favourable weather conditions! The helicopter pilot drives the herd straight into the funnel, directly into the vehicles...and on their way to a new home.

programme.title: Guizhou Golden Monkey & Fanjing Mountains
programme.desc: For the first time, see the incredible images of the Guizhou Golden Monkey population, captured by China’s scientific research station in the Fanjing Mountains and taken over a few years using infrared cameras.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "One Bad Apple"
programme.desc: As India’s government clamps down on marauding macaques in the capital, Delhi, the troublemaker Zamir steals ice cream from a child, bringing the country’s leading monkey catcher racing back to Jaipur.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "Return of the Rebel"
programme.desc: Cunning Zamir finds himself a new troop to join, while little Kavi is prepared for release back onto Jaipur’s streets.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "The Great Escape"
programme.desc: Kavi is released and disappears into the city, whilst Zamir and his new gang raid an office. The monkey catcher traps the troop’s alpha male, Vasu, leaving Zamir set for leadership.

programme.title: A Dog's Life S1 - "Sparkplug the Dalmatian"
programme.desc: Sparkplug is a gentle Dalmatian who is secretly dropped at The North Shore Animal League at the crack of dawn. The staff at the League tries to find a way to get Sparkplug back to their shelter, where her life would be saved.

programme.title: A Dog's Life S1 - "Every Breath"
programme.desc: Debbie, recently evicted from her apartment, hopes the North Shore Animal League will help her beloved pet Shorty find a new home. And Bailey has a serious case of pneumonia. While her owner waits and worries at home, Bailey sits in one of the League’s oxygen tents, fighting for every breath.

programme.title: A Dog's Life S1 - "Hurricanes"
programme.desc: Director of Operations, Paul Greene and dog trainer Mike Malloy head south to Florida, where they get ready to save adoptable dogs left homeless after Hurricanes. And Sparkplug must be admitted to the medical unit to treat pneumonia.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "THE SPECIALISTS"
programme.desc: Within this natural world lie countless hidden worlds, which each animal perceives in its own way, with its own highly tuned senses. These are the Specialists.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "AIR FORCES"
programme.desc: Some animals have the aerial advantage. They’re the fearless fliers that have the battlefield covered, scoping out the situation with super senses and the right stuff.

programme.title: Animals at Work S1 - "Pet Fashion Week"
programme.desc: A handsome and photogenic Australian Shepherd, four-year-old Ernie is a professional model at the peak of his career.

programme.title: Animals at Work S1 - "Performing Sea Lions"
programme.desc: Sister sea lions, Poppy and Lola, love to perform for their fans at Scotland’s Blair Drummond Safari Park.

programme.title: Animals at Work S1 - "Rabbit Model Competition"
programme.desc: Tom the trainer hopes his mascara-eyed Hotots, Polkadot and Domino, will take top honors at the upcoming rare breed rabbit championships, and meet a one tonne baby white rhino teacher in South Africa.

programme.title: Doug to the Rescue S2 - "Dixie Fire Foxes"
programme.desc: After the Dixie Fire devastates the CA town of Greenville, Doug heads in with his old friend Shannon to rescue the lost cats and wild animals that have been left behind.

programme.title: Doug to the Rescue S2 - "Tornado Town"
programme.desc: In the season finale, Doug takes his drone to the tornado-ravaged twons of Kentucky to rescue the slew of cats and dogs that have been lost in the brutal December storm.

programme.title: Roaring With Pride S1 - "Predators’ Progress"
programme.desc: The lions attempt to dig a warthog out of his hole, while an influx of volunteers have arrived and Nathan instructs them with an induction talk on how to treat, walk and cope with lions.

programme.title: Wild Ones S1 - "BIGGEST"
programme.desc: Wild Ones draws inspiration from the rhythms of nature, delving into the wonders of the animal kingdom. This captivating series explores the diverse behaviors that define survival—hunting and feeding strategies, family bonds, defense tactics, and the intricacies of courtship and mating. Who reigns supreme in the wild? Discover the untold stories of nature's fiercest competitors and most fascinating creatures.

programme.desc: Wild Ones draws inspiration from the rhythms of nature, delving into the wonders of the animal kingdom. Who reigns supreme in the wild? Discover the untold stories of nature's fiercest competitors and most fascinating creatures.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Tank"
programme.desc: Stacey battles to save a severely injured hunting dog, Millie the calf has been mauled by a dog and the Mark and Stacey work together to change the gender of a cat.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "UFO"
programme.desc: Meg the Labrador has swallowed a UFO, Chocolate the horse is suffering from asthma and Mark and Stacey compete in a chilli eating challenge.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Boss"
programme.desc: Boss the dog has a nasty injury from a possum trap, the fire brigade are called to save a cat stuck up a tree and Mark and Stacey compete in a fireman’s challenge.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Hurricanes"
programme.desc: Explore with us one of the most destructive and deadliest hurricanes in history!

programme.title: Past, Present, Future S1 - "...of Hallucinogens"
programme.desc: While psychedelics were originally seen as a tool for spiritual enlightenment and healing, new research and studies are revisiting psychedelics to reveal their potential clinical and therapeutic impact.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "Logistic 4.0"
programme.desc: Follow the parcel worldwide delivery technology.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "Energy Globe Award - Part 1"
programme.desc: Follow the feature about the 2022 award ceremony for sustainability projects that can change the world.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "Energy Globe Award - Part 2"
programme.desc: Follow the feature about the 2022 award ceremony for sustainability projects that can change the world.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "Fuel Cell Cars"
programme.desc: Learn about fuel cells as a sustainable alternative for cars and mobility in general.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Yemen Britain & The Saudis"
programme.desc: In March 2019 news reports appeared in the British press of UK’s troops being killed in Yemen, no one knew why they are there in the first place. Britain was not fighting a war in Yemen. This episode investigates the truth behind the casualties.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Somalia Pirates & Black Hawkdown"
programme.desc: On the 3 October 1993, an elite battle unit of the US army began a fairly straight-forward mission in Somalia’s capital Mogadishu. Within minutes of reaching their destination, the situation descended into chaos and the mission turned into a battle.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Battleground Bosnia"
programme.desc: On the 3 March 1992, Bosnia Herzegovina gained its independence from Yugoslavia. Immediately, the Serb-led military units took over large slabs of land and suppressed the other ethnic groups.

programme.title: TechKnow S1 - "Capturing Carbon"
programme.desc: A look at the science behind curtailing the dangerous effects of climate change by capturing CO2 and converting it into useable products.

programme.title: TechKnow S1 - "Disabled Life Enhancements"
programme.desc: Techknow looks at innovative solutions for accessibility and assistive technology to help persons with disabilities.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S2 - "Genius"
programme.desc: In this episode, Dr Jack Lewis investigates the neuroscience behind genius. He meets a genuine genius, Sabrina Chevannes, a woman with an IQ of 178 at just 4.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S2 - "Cyborg"
programme.desc: Dr Jack meets David Rose who uses a new technology that doesn’t work with his paralysed body – it actually taps directly into his mind.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S2 - "Music"
programme.desc: Dr Jack is going to sing with a choir like no other. Many of the members cannot talk, but they can sing!

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S2 - "Empathy"
programme.desc: We meet an individual who has an extraordinary neurological condition, mirror touch synaesthesia, allows them to feel the exact sensation or emotion of another.

programme.title: Nigel Latta Blows Stuff Up S1 - "Fire"
programme.desc: What really happens in a house fire ? Nigel sets out to get the answer by setting a house on fire. The results are surprising.

programme.title: Nigel Latta Blows Stuff Up S1 - "Space"
programme.desc: Nigel wants to be the first New Zealander to make it into space. To do so he explores the fundamental physics of rocket science, and demonstrates the sometimes wayward nature of science.

programme.title: Nigel Latta Blows Stuff Up S1 - "Sound"
programme.desc: Breaking the sound barrier. A good excuse for Nigel to invent some crazy experiments, and break a few other things along the way. Using some clever models, including 150 school students with flags, he examines the fundamentals of sound.

programme.title: Nigel Latta Blows Stuff Up S1 - "Gravity"
programme.desc: Gravity is usually associated with names like Galileo and Isaac Newton. Nigel tests the fundamentals of gravity through some interesting and innovative experiments.

programme.title: Digits S1 - "Man vs. Machine"
programme.desc: Get a sneak peek into how the Internet of Things will soon dominate daily life. As Edward Snowden provocatively points out, “TV is a medium that you watch. The Internet is a medium that watches you as you watch it.”

programme.title: Digits S1 - "Guardians of the Web"
programme.desc: Explore how our reliance on the web creates vulnerability to everything from cyber theft to an Internet system failure. Muller introduces viewers to “white hat” hackers, the U.S. Secret Service’s cybercrime division and even West Point soldiers.

programme.title: Trajectory S1 - "To the Moon"
programme.desc: TO THE MOON - The Apollo program achieves its major objective. DRAGON, FALCON AND SPACEX - New directions in re-usable spacecraft. GAIA - Mapping our galaxy in unprecedented detail.

programme.title: Trajectory S1 - "End of Apollo"
programme.desc: THE BEGINNING OF THE END - After the first Moon landing the Apollo science program was about to start in earnest but people were losing interest. APOLLO GETS COMPLICATED - New technology is added that extends the reach of the Apollo program.

programme.title: Trajectory S1 - "Return to Space"
programme.desc: THE SHUTTLE PROGRAM - The first re-useable spacecraft. THE CHALLENGER DISASTER - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. RETURN TO SPACE - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.

programme.title: Trajectory S1 - "Final Years"
programme.desc: THE SPACE SHUTTLE MATURES - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. COMPLEX CONSTRUCTION IN SPACE - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers forget the lessons of the past.

programme.title: The Age of Robots S1 - "The Bionic Man"
programme.desc: From brainda to eyes, hands to legs, and deep down to the internal organs: implants, prosthesis and rehabilitation are entering a new era potentially creating a new type of human being - The Bionic Man.

programme.title: The Age of Robots S1 - "Entertainment Robots"
programme.desc: In the future will we spend our leisure time with smart and sohisticated machines designed for fun - Entertainment Robots? Marvel at Mantis, a two ton insect and Tradinno, a giant fire-spitting dragon. Then take a seat and watch a mechanical actor and a robotic pianist perform.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Striker II, Navy Drones, F35B Fighter"
programme.sub-title: Striker II, Navy Drones, F35B Fighter
programme.desc: We have rare acces to BAE Systems. At their research centre in Kent, they're developing the futuristic Striker II helmet giving fighter pilots the edge in aerial combat

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Live Fire Exercises, Body Armor, Armored Vehicle AJAX"
programme.sub-title: Live Fire Exercises, Body Armor, Armored Vehicle AJAX
programme.desc: Discover the latest innovations in kit and equipment at the key military and security exhibition in the UK; Lockheed Martin's heat-seeking Indago drone; and the tech spec on the British Army's new armored vehicle, the AJAX.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Battlefield 3-D, Drone Tech, 2-man Orcasub"
programme.desc: The innovative combination of 3D video and drone technology gives infantry soldiers an accurate battlefield picture. Northrop Grumman's top European executive shares their predictions on how technology will change the way we fight.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "USS Zumwalt, Tank Training, Special Forces Vehicle"
programme.sub-title: USS Zumwalt, Tank Training, Special Forces Vehicle
programme.desc: We reveal eye-witness intelligence on the USS Zumwalt, America's ultra-hi tech, four billion dollar guided missile destroyer. Learn more about the British firm who've developed Minerva, an ingenious, low-cost but realistic tank simulator.

programme.title: Zenith: Advances in Space Exploration S1 - "The Launchers"
programme.desc: This episode examines a range of launchers that are integral to space research.

programme.title: Zenith: Advances in Space Exploration S1 - "Mars"
programme.desc: This episode looks at the work of the probes orbiting Mars and the rovers exploring its surface.

programme.title: Zenith: Advances in Space Exploration S1 - "Saturn"
programme.desc: This episode reveals the work done by the Cassini probe that spent more than 13 years examining the Saturnian system.

programme.title: Zenith: Advances in Space Exploration S1 - "The International Space Station"
programme.desc: This episode exposes the working life of people who spend months orbiting in micro gravity.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "The Planet Makers"
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our Solar System four and half billion years ago there remains tantalizing clues to its evolution; remnent debris: asteroids and comets. Now within our grasp these rocks of ice and dust are ready to give up their secrets.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "The Ice Giants"
programme.desc: Beyond the asteroid belt lay the ice giants, some can be seen with the naked eye, others only glimpsed once by a passing probe. We are again sending cameras to the edge of the solar system giving us new insights into the evolution of our worlds.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "The Moons of Olympus"
programme.desc: These are the the Moon's of the gas giants. Each a unique and mysterious world of its own. All are worthy of much more scrutiny.

programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Majestic View Created by the Nature, Jeju
programme.desc: The natural environment of deep blue sea and steep cliffs under the azure sky makes a majestic view around the island of Jeju. The lava flowed from the volcano of the island created a spectacular landscape in corners of Jeju such as Seongsan Ilchulbong Peak and pillar-shaped cliffs on the coast. The heavenly combination between the sky, the ocean and the bold cliffs by the shore. Here, we present the mysterious land of Jeju.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Island of Wind and Stones
programme.desc: Experience a day in Seongeup Folk Village of Jeju, the island of wind and stones. Jeju has long been referred to samdado (island of three many) because it is abundant with wind, stones and women. The thatched houses in Jeju were wisely constructed with stones as soil is not sufficient, and in a way to embrace strong winds.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Mt. Halla Gave birth to and the Sea embraced, Jeongbang Waterfall, Jeju Island
programme.desc: Jeongbang Waterfall in Jeju Island, or province is the Orient's only seaside fall which its waters drop directly into the sea, the form of which is pretty much rare worldwide.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The landscape of Jeju Island from which you are able to sees Mt. Sanbang
programme.desc: Let's appreciate the diverse appearance of Mt. Sanbang, a mountain which is considered as a signature tourist destination in Jeju due to an wonderful scenery of rising high against the backdrop of the clear and blue sky and the wide plain.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The green life force which was brought on by ocean currents The Colony of Cacti, located at Weolryong-ri, Jeju
programme.desc: In Weolryong-ri, Jeju, you can see the Korea's only and single colony of cacti which are dashed from the tropical region riding on the ocean currents and grow wild.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Cheonjeyeon Warm-Temperate Forest, Jeju
programme.desc: The primitive forest which is deep blue in four seasons

programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Coast of Yongmeori, Jeju Which the Volcanic Piled Over and the Waves Cut
programme.desc: When a volcanic erupted here in the shallow sea 1.8 million years ago, the fragmental matters spewed and piled up one by one neatly. And the strata again was eroded by wave and wind for tens of thousand years. The Coast of Yongmeori, located at Sagye-ri, Jeju Province is the product of such processes.

programme.title: The Magic of the Mangroves
programme.desc: Mangroves are one of the most important habitats on Earth, vital to many of the planet's most extraordinary, wonderful and endangered species. Everything from shorebirds and sharks to monkeys and manatees rely on mangroves. And although we tend to view them as a mess of tangled roots, mosquitoes and mud, they're also crucial for safeguarding the well-being of humans. Once we start explore this unique landscape there's no doubt that we will be just as enchanted as wildlife by the magic of mangroves.

programme.title: Urban Warriors
programme.desc: As human populations grow, so does our footprint, and more of the natural world is gradually paved over, displacing animals from their natural homes.

programme.title: Endagered with Michaela Strachen
programme.desc: This episode takes us to the heart of African game. This is the land with large mammals so unique to Africa. Species that requires massive territories, carnivores like the African Wild dogs, has become persecuted to the point of becoming most endangered mammal in Africa.

programme.title: The Power of Plants Race to Grow and Breed
programme.desc: Just like animals, the lives of plants are dominated by the need to become strong and pass on genes to the next generation – a race to grow and breed. They must race to beat their competition to the best light spots, and to make the most of perilously short seasons. And also like in the animal kingdom, different species have developed a near unending list of strategies to ensure their legacy is passed on. Our ideas about plants need a seed change – it's time to respect the power of plants.

programme.title: Mind of a Giant
programme.desc: What is it like to be an elephant? This series reveals new research which attempts to answer that question.

programme.title: Seasons of the Forest
programme.desc: No place on Earth is more changeable than the seasonal forest, undergoing radical transformations year after year. These adaptations to the seasons are what makes our woodlands so varied and dynamic a cycle of interwoven behaviors and practices ticking away like a Swiss watch to rejuvenate the landscape ready for the new year. To fully understand the stories of the great woodlands spend a year among the trees, watching the energetic and vibrant changes that mark the seasons of the forest.
